notes.title: Not Tonight 2 is OUT NOW on Switch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041421/93361529b24e0f9f890c23c3e1217815a41df255.png[/img]

Hey everyone! The day is here!

[h3]Not Tonight 2 is out now on Nintendo Switch![/h3]

Play as Kevin, Mari & Malik as you roadtrip through a political, dystopian America, while making some tough decisions along the way! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041421/04a853f5c1e18e63afd1bcd062664165d639b730.gif[/img]

Whether it's turning away suspicious poultry at Chief's Chickens, or getting in touch with your religious side at Salt Lake City - you're going to be one step closer to reaching Miami and rescuing your friend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041421/55905d696782e2456be99fd94ede0c7278a3124c.gif[/img]

If you fancy playing Not Tonight 1 & 2 on Steam, they're both discounted right now! Go back to where it all started in a very Brexit Britain in Not Tonight!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/733790/Not_Tonight/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1600370/Not_Tonight_2/

notes.title: Not Tonight 2 is coming to Switch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041421/de1fa3ec16fb5aad7fda6ebec5dbfcd8f7022eea.png[/img]

Hi everyone!

[h3]It's official - Not Tonight 2 will be launching on Nintendo Switch on March 27th!
[/h3]

Now, you can take a roadtrip through a very broken America, wherever you are! Your friend needs you - will you get to Miami in time?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041421/d75b9133518d5c459d10521841fe9cf451e0a9cf.gif[/img]

You can pre-order Not Tonight 2 on the Nintendo Switch store right now, ready to play on March 27th!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041421/848ebccd70a19a7b16c8013727656a6e9a68c8ff.gif[/img]

Don't forget, you can grab both Not Tonight 1 & 2 at a discount from the Steam Spring Sale! Go back to where it all started, in a harsh, post-Brexit Britain!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/733790/Not_Tonight/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1600370/Not_Tonight_2/

notes.title: THE NOT TONIGHT 2 BETA IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Great news everyone! 
[h2]
THE NOT TONIGHT 2 BETA IS NOW LIVE! [/h2]

Head out from Seattle to play a section of levels from the first road trip, then play some never before seen levels from the second road trip as you accompany Malik across middle America! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041421/b8ebdd5e644d812d4009ca324781eb1e4ca408a9.jpg[/img]

If you've signed up through our form, keep checking your emails as your key should be with you very soon - make sure you check all your tabs and spam if your key hasn't arrived yet!

If you DIDN'T manage to sign up in time, fear not! You can grab a key here: https://gleam.io/OSKIT/play-the-not-tonight-2-beta-now

We cannot WAIT to hear what you make of our new levels - let us know in the forums or join us over on [url=discord.gg/nottonight]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: THE WAIT IS ALMOST OVER! Not Tonight 2 is coming FEBRUARY 11TH!
notes.content:
[h3]Calling all bouncers, you're needed to start work in America on [b]FEBRUARY 11th![/b] 

If that wasn't enough, you can dive in EARLY and play our FINAL beta from FRIDAY, JANUARY 28TH! If you played the first beta, you won't want to miss this one! We've included some new levels for you to try, but don't worry, your favourite wizards will still be there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32463969/fd5cc14f68caa64563844dae71b5979ef5e43ce0.png[/img]

You'll need to think on your feet and work hard to safely cross America, but with your skills and the help of your friends (and enemies!), we're sure you'll make it in time to save your friends! 

With launch so close, we couldn't WAIT to show you some brand new levels and get you involved right before the end - we can't WAIT for you to get your hands on the whole game!

As always, there will also be NO EMBARGO during the beta, so you can share videos, screenshots, and stream the game as much as you like! You can also join the official Not Tonight Discord to share your thoughts on the beta with our very friendly community! While you're there, you can take part in the metagames too!  

You can join here: [url=discord.gg/nottonight]discord.gg/nottonight[/url]

You can sign up for the beta right now and GUARANTEE yourself a key for when it launches on January 28th: [url=https://forms.gle/4QPKE69wRHTxA9sa6]https://forms.gle/4QPKE69wRHTxA9sa6[/url]

Click here to wishlist:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1600370/Not_Tonight_2/

notes.title: Not Tonight 2 BETA coming September 24th!
notes.content:
[h3]Not Tonight fans, we have some BIG news for you!

We are excited to introduce the NOT TONIGHT 2 BETA, STARTING SEPTEMBER 24TH!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041421/94610128b40df2ba71421bcd9a2ca1c6f1d0a99a.jpg[/img]

A very broken America is in urgent need of bouncers, and your missing friend needs you! Stay out of trouble, keep your nose clean, and the American dream may still be very much alive...

Now is your chance to try out a preview of the game before its full launch -  but don't worry, we've got plenty of content in the beta to tide you over!

There will also be NO EMBARGO during the beta, so you can share videos, screenshots, and stream the game as much as you like! You can also join the official Not Tonight Discord to share your thoughts on the beta with our very friendly community! While you're there, you can take part in the metagames too!  

You can join here: [url=discord.gg/nottonight]discord.gg/nottonight[/url]

You can sign up for the beta right now and GUARANTEE yourself a key for when it launches on 24th September: [url=https://bit.ly/nt2beta]https://bit.ly/nt2beta[/url]

Be sure to share your thoughts and feedback with us during the beta - we want to make Not Tonight 2 as perfect as it can be! So enjoy the road trip, and don't get caught up in any illegal activities! But then again, is anyone really following the law?

Click here to wishlist:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1600370/Not_Tonight_2/

notes.title: Take an early look at NOT TONIGHT 2 in our Discord!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone! 

A little while back we announced NOT TONIGHT 2 - the story of 3 bouncers crossing a disunited America to save their friend from a Miami gulag. It's still very much got Not Tonight at it's heart, but there are definitely some interesting changes that the team are very proud of!  So proud in fact, we've started sharing some of the ways Not Tonight 2 feels fresh and new, as well as some insights into development in our Discord! 

[url=discord.gg/nottonight]Join our discord here:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32463969/bed087dd15454e223490323643ba1b2e2433b095.png[/img][/url]

If you're interested in how the game is coming along and want some peeks into what you can expect, we're sharing them every week over in the discord! You'll be able to find new screenshots, gifs and some write-ups on what's new in our dedicated updates channel, and if you're looking to get into the spirit of uniting a broken America, we're also running a meta-game where you can pick your team and play to save your country, in whatever way you can! 

We'll see you in the Discord - discord.gg/nottonight [/h3]
